# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）三大业务分部完整分析报告

> 数据来源：Microsoft FY26 Q4 财报材料包中的 `financial_statements.txt`（Segment Results 工作表）、`press_release.txt`、`transcript.txt`（FY26 Q4 电话会）、`10k.txt`（FY26 Form 10-K，Note 18 – Segment Information）。所有金额单位为百万美元（除非另注）。

---

## 一、分部详细财务数据（Q4 FY26 vs Q4 FY25）

### 1. Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与业务流程）

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入（Revenue） | $37,847 | $33,112 | +14.3%（电话会口径 +14%，恒定汇率 +14%） |
| 营业成本（Cost of revenue） | $6,989 | $6,042 | +15.7% |
| 经营费用（Operating expenses） | $8,958 | $8,077 | +10.9% |
| 经营利润（Operating income） | $21,900 | $18,993 | +15.3% |
| 经营利润率（Operating margin） | 57.9% | 57.4% | +0.5pp |

**驱动因素（电话会 Amy Hood 原文）**：
- "M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."
- "net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter."
- "M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."
- "M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth."
- "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."
- "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable."

**利润率说明（电话会原文）**：
- "Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains."
- "Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier."
- "Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."

---

### 2. Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入（Revenue） | $39,306 | $29,878 | +31.6%（电话会口径 +32%，恒定汇率 +31%） |
| 营业成本（Cost of revenue） | $16,876 | $11,845 | +42.5% |
| 经营费用（Operating expenses） | $6,475 | $5,893 | +9.9% |
| 经营利润（Operating income） | $15,955 | $12,140 | +31.4% |
| 经营利润率（Operating margin） | 40.6% | 40.6% | 基本持平（电话会口径"relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%"） |

**驱动因素（电话会 Amy Hood 原文）**：
- "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."
- "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."
- "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."
- "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency."

**利润率说明（电话会原文）**：
- "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."
- "Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."
- "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."
- "Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

---

### 3. More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入（Revenue） | $12,854 | $13,451 | -4.4%（电话会口径 -4%，恒定汇率 -5%） |
| 营业成本（Cost of revenue） | $5,660 | $6,127 | -7.6% |
| 经营费用（Operating expenses） | $4,446 | $4,134 | +7.5% |
| 经营利润（Operating income） | $2,748 | $3,190 | -13.9% |
| 经营利润率（Operating margin） | 21.4% | 23.7% | -2.3pp（电话会口径"operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%"） |

**驱动因素（电话会 Amy Hood 原文）**：
- "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support."
- "Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."
- "XBOX revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."

**利润率说明（电话会原文）**：
- "Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."
- "Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."
- "Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."

> 电话会另披露：XBOX 业务本季度包含"severance expense and impairment charges in XBOX"，是导致 OpEx 增长和 OI 下滑的直接原因之一。Satya Nadella 在电话会开场亦表示："we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth... expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."

---

## 二、全公司合计数与分部勾稽验证

### Q4 FY26 全公司合计（来源：financial_statements.txt Income Statements + Segment Results）

| 指标 | 三个分部加总 | 全公司报表数 | 是否勾稽 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $90,007 | $90,007 | ✅ 一致 |
| 营业成本 | $29,525 | $29,525 | ✅ 一致 |
| 经营费用 | $19,879 | $19,879 | ✅ 一致 |
| 经营利润 | $40,603 | $40,603 | ✅ 一致 |

### 各分部内部勾稽（Rev − COGS − OpEx = OI）

- **PBP**：$37,847 − $6,989 − $8,958 = $21,900 ✅（与报表 OI 一致）
- **IC**：$39,306 − $16,876 − $6,475 = $15,955 ✅（与报表 OI 一致）
- **MPC**：$12,854 − $5,660 − $4,446 = $2,748 ✅（与报表 OI 一致）

### Q4 FY25 同期对照（同上方法验证，全部一致）

| 指标 | 全公司报表 |
|---|---|
| 收入 | $76,441 |
| 营业成本 | $24,014 |
| 经营费用 | $18,104 |
| 经营利润 | $34,323 |

### 关键同比汇总

| 指标 | 全公司 | PBP | IC | MPC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入同比 | +18% | +14% | +32% | -4% |
| 营业成本同比 | +23% | +16% | +43% | -8% |
| 经营费用同比 | +10% | +11% | +10% | +8% |
| 经营利润同比 | +18% | +15% | +31% | -14% |
| 经营利润率 | 45.1% | 57.9% | 40.6% | 21.4% |

> 注：全公司经营利润率 45.1%（$40,603/$90,007），与电话会 Amy Hood 所言 "Operating margins increased slightly year-over-year to 45%" 一致。

---

### Microsoft Cloud（跨分部汇总指标，来源：metrics.txt）

- Microsoft Cloud 收入：$59.3B，+27%（恒定汇率 +27%）
- Microsoft Cloud 毛利率：65%（同比下降，因销售结构向 Azure 倾斜 + AI 基础设施投入）
- 商业剩余履约义务（RPO）：$678B，+84%（其中约 30% 将在未来 12 个月确认为收入，同比 +37%）

---

## 四、口径提示与使用注意事项

读者在使用上述数字时，需特别注意以下口径问题（均来源于官方披露）：

**1. 分部间分配与不可直接比较性**
- 10-K Note 18 明确指出："Revenue from certain contracts is allocated among the segments based on the relative value of the underlying products and services… Cost of revenue is allocated in certain cases based on a relative revenue methodology. Operating expenses that are allocated primarily include those relating to our investments in AI infrastructure and training… and are generally allocated based on relative gross margin."
- 即：各分部的成本/费用并非完全独立核算，存在跨分部分配。因此**各分部经营利润率不可直接横向比较**（PBP 58% vs IC 41% vs MPC 21%，差异主要反映业务结构而非管理效率优劣）。

**2. Microsoft Cloud 是跨分部汇总指标**
- Microsoft Cloud 收入 = M365 Commercial cloud + Azure + LinkedIn 商业部分 + Dynamics 365，跨越 PBP 和 IC 两个分部。它不是独立的第四个分部，**不可与任一单分部加总**，否则会重复计算。

**3. GAAP vs 非 GAAP（OpenAI 影响）**
- 本季度 OpenAI 投资对净利润的影响为 +$480M（+EPS $0.07），对经营利润**无影响**（OI GAAP = 非 GAAP = $40,603M）。
- 收入、经营利润、经营费用、COGS 均为 GAAP 口径，不含 OpenAI 调整。

**4. 恒定汇率（Constant Currency）**
- 增长率有"报告口径"和"恒定汇率口径"两套。恒定汇率用上年同期汇率重新折算本期外币实体数据，用于剥离汇率波动。本季度汇率对总收入影响 +$391M（约 0.5pp）。

**5. 季度季节性**
- 10-K 明确说明："Our revenue fluctuates quarterly and is generally higher in the fourth quarter of our fiscal year." Q4 为全年旺季（本季收入占全年 27.1%），跨季度比较需注意季节性。

**6. 一次性事项影响**
- 本季度包含多项 discrete items，对 EPS 净影响 +$0.27：Anthropic 投资 +$3.2B 收益、Voluntary Retirement Program 费用低于预期，部分被 XBOX 裁员补偿和减值抵消。这些主要影响 MPC 分部 OpEx 和公司其他损益，**不影响分部收入**。
- Amy Hood 原文："When adjusting for these items, we exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income and earnings per share."

**7. 固定资产使用寿命变更（前瞻性）**
- 自 FY27 起，数据中心和办公楼的预计使用寿命从 15 年延长至 25 年。Amy Hood 称"impact on FY27 operating income is expected to be minimal"，但"more of our future datacenter leases will shift from finance leases to operating leases"，CapEx 口径将调整至约 $175B。

**8. 分部报告边界**
- 10-K Note 18："Assets are not allocated to segments for internal reporting presentations." 因此**分部层面无总资产披露**，只有公司层面资产负债表。

---

## 五、结论摘要

- **Intelligent Cloud** 是本季度增长主引擎（收入 +32%，Azure +43%），但 COGS 同步飙升 +43%，毛利率承压，OpEx 仅 +10%，杠杆效应显著，OI +31%，利润率稳定在 ~41%。
- **Productivity and Business Processes** 稳健增长（收入 +14%），M365 Copilot 付费席位突破 3000 万、净增环比翻倍，ARPU 提升驱动高质量增长，利润率小幅扩张至 57.9%，是所有分部中利润率最高的。
- **More Personal Computing** 是唯一下滑分部（收入 -4%），受 Windows OEM 需求疲弱、Xbox 内容服务高基数以及组件成本上涨拖累；尽管毛利率因 Activision 摊销减少而改善，但 XBOX 减值与裁员费用推高 OpEx +8%，导致 OI -14%，利润率收缩至 21%。
- **全公司**：收入 $90.0B（+18%），经营利润 $40.6B（+18%），经营利润率 45.1%，毛利率 67%（下降 1pp，因 Azure 销售结构倾斜与 AI 投入），三部门勾稽完全一致。
- Satya Nadella 在电话会总结："It was a very strong close to what was a record fiscal year for us." 全年 Azure 收入首超 $100B，M365 Copilot 付费席位超 3000 万。
